title: Spiral Matrix
description: Given an `m x n` matrix, return all of its elements in **spiral order**: start at the top-left, go right along the top row, then down the right column, then left along the bottom row, then up the left column, and keep spiraling inward.
hints: Keep four boundaries (top, bottom, left, right) and shrink them after traversing each side.
After the top row and the right column, check that rows/columns remain before traversing the other two sides.
